subject.title: fix(agents): skip model-override repair and visibility gate for locked sessions

question: Should `modelSelectionLocked: true` authorize every owning plugin session to bypass `agents.defaults.models` visibility during execution, or should the exemption be limited to a narrower trusted session shape?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but this choice defines a compatibility-sensitive plugin/session contract and changes which provider/model routes may execute despite user visibility configuration; repository source cannot safely infer the intended precedence.

options.title: Make the lock authoritative
options.body: Treat every valid plugin-owned locked session as preserving its stored execution route, keep both selector exemptions, and require regression coverage for ordinary sessions still honoring visibility.

options.title: Narrow the exemption
options.body: Require recognized harness or catalog-adoption provenance in addition to the lock before bypassing visibility, preserving the allowlist for other locked rows.

options.title: Keep visibility authoritative
options.body: Reject the bypass and instead make the owning provider publish adopted model routes into the model catalog and configured visibility path.

recommendation.title: Make the lock authoritative
recommendation.body: Treat every valid plugin-owned locked session as preserving its stored execution route, keep both selector exemptions, and require regression coverage for ordinary sessions still honoring visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans core agent runtime, plugin ownership, model visibility, and the adjacent release surface rather than a single local helper.
